title: AWS Data Architect
description:
About the Role

AWS Data Architect – Hybrid Cloud, Data Migration & Legacy Modernization

We are seeking an AWS Data Architect with deep expertise in hybrid cloud environments, on-prem to AWS migrations, ETL modernization, and legacy application analysis. This role will lead the transformation of multiple traditional on-premise systems—including databases, applications, ETL pipelines, and BI workloads—into modern, scalable cloud architectures.

You will work across several business verticals (HR, Corporate Finance, and Real Estate), collaborating closely with Cloud Engineering, Cloud Operations, BI, Data, and Application teams. The ideal candidate is hands-on, autonomous, and highly skilled at reverse-engineering systems in environments with little or no documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture & Migration Strategy

· Lead end-to-end migration of on-prem systems (databases, applications, ETL, BI workloads) into AWS.

· Work with Oracle, SQL Server, ODI, legacy ETL flows, Java, Angular, OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, and BI Publisher.

· Define migration paths (lift-and-shift, re-platform, modernization).

· Architect AWS solutions leveraging services such as S3, Glue, Athena, DMS, EC2, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, IAM.

· Ensure data and application continuity for systems that remain on-prem.

· Contribute to data lake and analytical architecture design.

Legacy System Assessment

· Independently analyze and document complex legacy systems covering:

o Oracle & SQL Server structures, dependencies, logic, triggers, procedures.

o ODI mappings, packages, workflows, and transformations.

o Java and Angular applications and their data interactions.

o BI metadata layers and report logic (OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher).

o Batch processes, data flows, and integrations across HR, Finance, and Real Estate.

· Reverse-engineer systems with minimal support or documentation.

Hybrid Architecture & Data Synchronization

· Design architectures that span on-premise and AWS environments.

· Support scenarios where significant workloads remain on-prem.

· Build synchronization patterns for:

o On-prem ETL (ODI) sustaining local applications.

o Cloud ingestion for analytics and reporting.

· Ensure reliability and performance across hybrid data flows.

· Collaborate with infrastructure teams on Direct Connect, VPN, and related networking.

Data Engineering & ETL Modernization

· Translate business logic from Oracle/SQL Server into cloud-native technologies.

· Modernize ETL from ODI into AWS Glue, Python, SQL (Athena/PostgreSQL).

· Reimplement complex transformation rules while preserving business logic.

· Support semantic layer design, data modeling, and analytical datasets.

BI & Data Warehouse Migration

· Migrate BI workloads (OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher) into AWS.

· Rebuild and validate BI logic within cloud-based architectures.

· Apply data warehouse concepts (dimensional modeling, marts, semantic layers).

· Partner with BI teams on testing and rollout.

Compliance, Governance & Cloud Standards

· Operate within established cloud guardrails, IAM policies, and security frameworks.

· Ensure architecture aligns with organizational standards.

· Collaborate with Cloud Engineering and Cloud Operations for governance and infrastructure.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Engage with business analysts, data owners, and application teams.

· Work across diverse business domains with complex data landscapes.

· Maintain alignment with cloud, BI, data, and application initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

· Strong experience designing hybrid cloud architectures (on-prem + AWS).

· Deep knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server, including advanced logic.

· Hands-on experience with ODI/ODEE and ETL reverse engineering.

· Experience with Tableau, Qlik, ThoughtSpot, or similar BI tools.

· Understanding of Java, Angular, and reporting/BI applications.

· Experience with OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher.

· Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehouse concepts, and analytical systems.

· Proficiency with AWS services: S3, Glue, Athena, DMS, EC2, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, IAM.

· Experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, VPN).

· Proficiency in Python.

Behavioral & Professional Skills

· Highly independent, resourceful, and comfortable with ambiguity.

· Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and critical thinking skills.

· Curious and proactive learner, able to master unfamiliar systems quickly.

· Hands-on, ownership-driven mindset.

· Strong communication and documentation capabilities.

· Ability to work across diverse business domains and technical stacks.

· Fluent English.

Nice to Have

· Exposure to financial or banking data domains.

· AWS Certifications: Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, Developer.

· Knowledge of Azure or other cloud providers in legacy environments.

Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Remote from Brazil.

Why build your carrer at Meta?

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.

What are our values?

- We are people serving people

- We all think and act like owners

- We are hungry for performance

- We grow and learn together

- We pursue excellence and simplicity

- We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

Did you relate? Then, #ComeBeMeta!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Frontend Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

O Analista de frontend irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, com um potencial enorme de crescimento.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se do conhecimento avançado de tecnologias front-end envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a arquitetura front-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar, capacitar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Garantir a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
  • Contribuir em discussões sobre inovação e novas tendências de mercado através da constante atualização em tecnologias front-end com o intuito de disseminar o conhecimento entre a equipe;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos da área do produto ou segmento que estiver atuando com base em seu conhecimento técnico com o objetivo de otimizar as suas entregas e dos envolvidos.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação TypeScript – nível avançado;
  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação para front-end Angular – nível avançado;
  • Conceitos de DevOps (Observabilidade, SRE, outros) – nível básico;

  • Arquitetura de Software (sistemas distribuídos, escalabilidade, Cloud Native, microsserviços, contêineres, outros) – nível avançado;
  • Sistemas distribuídos (contêineres, kubernetes, swarm, outros) – nível básico;
  • Testes unitários, técnicas de manutenibilidade e resolução de vulnerabilidades - nível avançado;
  • Banco de Dados (SQL, NoSQL) – nível intermediário;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software –nível intermediário;

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

title: Gerente de Contratos e Governança Comercial
description:
O Grupo NTSec é o resultado da união da ZivaSec , NTSec , InfoSec e CloudSec , empresas do mercado de tecnologia. Somos uma plataforma de soluções inovadoras em segurança, com talentos excepcionais e o compromisso de conectar o futuro dos nossos clientes à proteção que eles precisam.

Com mais de 300 profissionais que chamamos de Secpowers ⚡ espalhados em todo o Brasil e temos escritórios em Brasília (DF), Cuiabá (MT), Curitiba (PR), Fortaleza (CE), Goiânia (GO), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , estamos em constante expansão.

Reconhecidos 3 vezes pelo Great Place to Work™ , temos uma cultura forte, baseada em inovação, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade e respeito .

Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, essa vaga pode ser sua!

Essa posição é para o profissional atuar como responsável central pela gestão do ciclo de vida dos contratos do Grupo NTSec, garantindo controle, governança, mitigação de riscos, expansão de base contratual e maximização de resultados financeiros, com forte interface entre as áreas jurídica, comercial, técnica e financeira.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão:

Gestão Contratual

  • Gerir o ciclo completo dos contratos: elaboração, análise, execução, acompanhamento, renovação e encerramento.
  • Controlar prazos, vigências, SLAs, penalidades, reajustes, índices e marcos contratuais.
  • Solicitar, acompanhar e formalizar aditivos contratuais (prazo, escopo, valor, reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro).

Governança, Compliance e Risco

  • Garantir aderência contratual às leis, normas regulatórias e políticas internas, especialmente em contratos públicos e de tecnologia.
  • Atuar na gestão de riscos contratuais, prevenindo passivos jurídicos, financeiros e operacionais.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, organizando documentação e evidências contratuais.

Expansão de Base e Receita

  • Identificar oportunidades de upsell, cross-sell e expansão de escopo dentro dos contratos vigentes.
  • Trabalhar junto ao time comercial para renovações estratégicas, renegociações e ampliação de contratos.
  • Apoiar estratégias de expansão de base instalada e recorrência (ARR).

Gestão de Garantias e Obrigações

  • Controlar garantias contratuais, seguros, fianças, cartas de garantia, performance bonds e garantias técnicas.
  • Monitorar obrigações contratuais relacionadas a fabricantes, parceiros e clientes.

Relatórios e Inteligência de Dados

  • Estruturar e manter controles, dashboards e relatórios gerenciais sobre contratos, riscos, valores, margens, renovações e oportunidades.
  • Fornecer informações estratégicas para a diretoria apoiar decisões de crescimento, investimentos e compliance.

Integração com Tecnologia

  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas técnicas (cibersegurança, infraestrutura, cloud), compreendendo escopos técnicos, SLAs, licenciamento, contratos de software, hardware, serviços e suporte.
  • Apoiar negociações e gestão contratual com fabricantes de tecnologia e distribuidores.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Direito ou áreas correlatas
  • Conhecimento sólido em gestão de contratos, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia, integradoras ou cibersegurança.
  • Experiência com contratos públicos e privados, aditivos, reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro e gestão de garantias.
  • Conhecimento de modelos contratuais de tecnologia: licenciamento de software, SaaS, hardware, suporte, SLAs, contratos de serviços gerenciados.
  • Familiaridade com compliance, governança corporativa e controles internos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de controle (Excel avançado, Power BI, ERP, CRM ou sistemas de gestão contratual).

E aí, deu match!? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time de secpowers ! ⚡

title: Finance & Payroll Specialist
description:
Finance & Payroll Specialist

Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor

Location: 100% remote

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Our Firm:

Sterlington is a full-service law firm that combines legal and commercial excellence with modern ways of practicing. Our high-caliber partners work on complex business matters with a tailored approach to client service and a focus on financial flexibility and innovation. Learn more at:

The Opportunity:

We're looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Accounts Payable & Payroll Specialist who takes ownership and gets things done. This isn't just about processing numbers—it's about being a trusted partner to our finance team and ensuring our people and vendors are paid accurately and on time, every time.

If you're someone who thrives on precision, stays ahead of deadlines, communicates effectively, and brings solutions (not just questions), we want to hear from you. You'll play a critical role in supporting our US-headquartered service business, managing everything from multi-system payroll processing to partner distributions and year-end compliance.

What You'll Do:

Payroll

  • Prepare and reconcile monthly payroll summaries with meticulous accuracy
  • Record payroll bills and journals, and process payments efficiently
  • Drive improvements and consolidation across multiple payroll systems (XE, Gusto, Ramp)
  • Create and distribute monthly payment summaries to law partners
  • Calculate origination partners' monthly distributions and annual true-ups
  • Maintain flawless payroll records, including salary changes, bonuses, benefits, and tax deductions
  • Partner closely with HR to ensure employee data is current and accurate
  • Reconcile benefits and 401K deductions with precision
  • Register with state authorities as needed to ensure all state filings are current
  • Proactively monitor and resolve payroll system exceptions and tax-related issues before they escalate
  • Own year-end payroll reporting, compliance, and filings (W-2s, 1099s, K-1s)
  • Support workers' compensation and other audits
  • Prepare ad hoc and monthly management compensation reports as needed

Accounts Payable

  • Review, verify, and process vendor invoices, reimbursements, and disbursements with accuracy and speed
  • Receive and answer questions about payments from team members and vendors.
  • Track payment approvals and due dates, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks
  • Maintain and monitor vendor records with a keen eye for detail
  • Reconcile AP aging reports and support monthly close processes
  • Calculate recruiter fees accurately
  • Record and reconcile law partner credit card transactions
  • Manage intercompany reconciliation for credit card transactions, payables, and expenses
  • Track and report monthly business development expenses per partner
  • Follow up with partners and their assistants for missing or incomplete information
  • Ensure complete accuracy of prepaid account balances, client reimbursables, and team member advances

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience in Payroll and Accounts Payable
  • US payroll expertise is essential. You must have hands-on experience with W-2s, 1099s, and K-1s, as well as all related state tax filings and registrations
  • Strong experience with payroll systems and maintaining accurate tax and state registration filings
  • Highly proactive mindset: you spot issues before they become problems and take initiative to resolve them
  • Exceptionally responsive, you understand urgency and prioritize accordingly
  • You take pride in completing your work with uncompromising accuracy, the first time.
  • You are a systems thinker and want to be part of the design process and program improvements within your area, and working across teams
  • Start-up / scale-up experience preferred
  • Professional services experience preferred
  • You are comfortable making systems change recommendations and assisting in the implementation of these changes.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment

Sterlington is a full-service law firm that combines legal and commercial excellence with modern ways of practicing.

  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants. Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written proficiency with English.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About Credix

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

As a Collections Specialist, your mission is to execute recoveries hands-on while building the foundations of a scalable, fair, and data-driven collections function.

You will work directly on active cases — negotiating, prioritizing, escalating, and resolving — while also turning what you learn into clear playbooks, policies, and operating processes.

This role sits at the intersection of execution and design:

  • You recover capital today
  • You help ensure we recover it better, faster, and more predictably tomorrow

Qualifications

  • Strong experience in collections in Brazil .
  • Fluent in Portuguese and basic English.
  • Solid understanding of legal and judicial recovery frameworks .
  • Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and cohorts .
  • Ability to reason about effort vs. yield economics .
  • Working knowledge of SQL / BI tools (hands-on or close collaboration).
  • Highly execution-oriented — comfortable being in the weeds.
  • Structured thinker who turns chaos into process.
  • Clear, practical communicator with Ops, Risk, and Legal.
  • Ownership mindset — sees gaps and fills them.

Responsibilities

  • Execute collections hands-on across delinquency stages and products.
  • Manage negotiations and recoveries , including complex or sensitive cases.
  • Help design and maintain collections playbooks and policies .
  • Continuously improve case prioritization and escalation logic .
  • Partner with Data to translate execution insights into better segmentation and models.
  • Support and monitor external partners (law firms, agencies).
  • Track and communicate recovery performance and operational insights.
  • Act as a builder of the collections function , not just an operator.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

Sobre a Empresa

A história do cooperativismo no Paraná é marcada por experiências de sucesso que uniram pequenos e médios produtores em torno de um objetivo comum: transformar a produção local em negócios sustentáveis de escala global.   • Excellent English communication skills

  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design

Desired Experience

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.

Our promise to you:

-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry

What we ask of you:

-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness

As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.

Who we are:

We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.

With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.

Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.

About the job:

The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.

Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.

Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory); Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.

About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.
  • Proven experience in delivering data studies focused on generating and sharing actionable data.
  • Deep understanding of statistical methods, including hypothesis testing and statistical modeling.
  • Proficiency in SQL for extracting data directly from source systems.
  • Sharp critical thinking and analytical problem-solving abilities.
  • Enjoy working in a dynamic environment with fast learning and deliveries.
  • Advanced English proficiency (conversational, listening, writing.)

Nice to Have:

  • Ability to perform data cleaning and processing steps using Python or R languages.
  • Hands-on experience in building Machine Learning models.

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Ventilaçao)
description:
Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Foco: Ventilação)
 
Excelente oportunidade para uma pessoa qualificada e com experiência na área de planejamento de mina, foco em ventilação.
 
A empresa
Nosso cliente é uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do mundo em atuação no país.
 
 A posição
Em um ambiente de mineração subterrânea onde a ventilação é o pilar fundamental da segurança e produtividade, você terá o desafio de conduzir o planejamento estratégico de sistemas de ventilação e refrigeração de minas subterrâneas. Essa posição exige expertise técnica para assegurar que a disciplina esteja em acordo com normas regulatórias e padrões internos. Trata-se de uma oportunidade única de planejar sistemas de ventilação de alta complexidade em minerações profundas. Suas decisões contribuirão diretamente em assegurar um ambiente de trabalho confortável e seguro para os times operacionais.
 
Responsabilidades
 
 Como especialista no tema, você será responsável por dimensionar e operacionalizar sistemas de ventilação que sustentem as operações de frentes de trabalho em acordo com o planejamento anual e estratégico de produção. Suas atribuições também incluem colaboração no design da mina, participação em projetos e comitês de emergência, execução de tarefas técnicas, com foco em resultados práticos e conformidade:
  • Simulação e Modelagem: Empregar softwares como Deswik, Ventsim para simulações termodinâmicas do fluxo de ar na mina, incluindo cenários de produção, dimensionamento de frota, geotermia bem como cenários de emergência. Validar os modelos com dados reais para assegurar a calibração do modelo.
  • Integração com Planos de Produção e Lavra: Analisar impactos básicos da ventilação em planos de lavra, desenvolvimento, sondagem e infraestrutura, colaborando com as diferentes áreas e assegurar resposta a variações operacionais. Ser o guardião dos padrões internos, assegurando equilíbrio entre segurança e metas de produção.
  • Conformidade com Normas Regulamentadoras: Garantir adesão às normas principais, como NR-22, ABNT NBR 16401, padrões internos da companhia, realizando revisões regulares e melhorias nos padrões.
  • Gestão de Perdas e Recirculações: Identificar perdas de ar através de inspeções em campo com instrumentos de medição, propor estratégias para reduzir recirculações, perdas. Interagir com as diversas disciplinas para construção do sequenciamento de atividades para melhorar a eficiência.
  • Melhoria de qualidade das instalações de ventilação: Desenvolver soluções com foco em melhores materiais, métodos ou tecnologias que assegurem a conformidade das vedações das estruturas que compõe o sistema de ventilação.
 
 Requisitos
É essencial que o profissional possua as seguintes habilidades e qualificações:
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia (Minas, Mecânica, Elétrica ou Civil) com CREA ativo.
  • Especialização: Conhecimentos em aerodinâmica básica de minas, segurança subterrânea e princípios de sistemas de ar, com interesse em certificações em ventilação.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Familiaridade com softwares de planejamento de minas (ex.: Deswik, Datamine) e ventilação (ex.: Ventsim). Elaboração de apresentações executivas. Análise estatística de dados. Compreensão de normas técnicas nacionais.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 4 anos em mineração subterrânea, com pelo menos 2 anos em atividades relacionadas a ventilação de minas subterrâneas. Experiência em projetos de média escala, incluindo monitoramento e ajustes operacionais.
 
Requisitos Desejáveis
  • Habilidades interpessoais para trabalho em equipe e poder de negociação.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times internacionais e compreensão de bibliografia técnica.
  • Pós-Graduação na área de Ventilação ou Engenharia de Minas;

A empresa proporcionará um pacote atrativo de remuneração e benefícios.

title: Legal Operations Specialist
description:
As a highly-regarded high-tech unicorn company, we have been making a positive global impact since 2013. Harnessing the power of innovative mobile technologies, our core product is redefining ride-hailing, while simultaneously introducing new business verticals that are propelling us toward becoming a super app. With our cutting-edge solutions and dynamic work environment, we provide a unique opportunity for individuals to contribute to our mission of combating injustice on a global scale.

The Legal Operations Specialist supports the legal department by driving operational efficiency, financial control, and process improvement. This role focuses heavily on legal budget management, vendor coordination, contract support, and compliance with financial and procurement procedures. Working closely with Legal, Finance, and external providers, the specialist ensures transparent cost control, effective legal workflows, and well-maintained legal tools and documentation, while also contributing to team development and collaboration initiatives.

NOTE: ONLY CVs in English will be accepted

Responsibilities:

  • Budget Management

-Planning and Allocation: Develop, consolidate, and allocate the annual legal budget. Coordinate with department heads to understand budgetary needs and constraints.

-Expense Tracking and Analysis: Track, analyze, and forecast legal expenses to ensure adherence to the budget and identify cost-saving opportunities. Generate regular financial reports detailing budget performance and variances.

-Collaboration: Work with the finance team to ensure alignment on budgetary matters, financial reporting and any necessary adjustments

  • Vendor Management

-Purchase Requisitions: Handle purchase requisitions in ERP system, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and policies.

-Contract Management: Negotiate and manage contracts with external legal service providers.

-Vendor Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding of new vendors and ensure compliance with company policies and guidelines.

-Billing: Work with external law firms and vendors to resolve billing discrepancies and improve billing processes.

  • Process Management

-Efficiency Improvement: Identify inefficiencies in current legal processes and recommend improvements.

-Implementation: Implement streamlined processes to enhance productivity, efficiency, and compliance.

-Monitoring: Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of process improvements.

  • Knowledge Management

-System Maintenance: Maintain and update legal knowledge management systems with current documentation and information.

-Resource Development: Develop and maintain user-friendly templates, forms, and documents to facilitate legal operations.

-Access and Accuracy: Ensure the legal team has easy access to accurate and up-to-date resources and guidelines.

-Best Practices: Promote best practices for knowledge sharing within the legal department.

  • Legal People & Culture

-Team Culture: Foster a positive and collaborative culture within the legal team through events and team-building activities.

-Training Programs: Organize training and development programs for the legal team.

-Employee Engagement: Support initiatives to enhance employee engagement and professional growth.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Legal, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience in a legal operations role or a similar operational capacity.
  • Excellent English communication and collaboration skills (B2 or higher).
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting.
  • Understanding of legal principles, practices, and terminology.
  • Familiarity with enterprise resource planning systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle).
  • Experience with legal technology software and tools (e.g., contract management systems, e-billing platforms, document automation tools, legal analytics tools).
  • Proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools.
  • Analytical Thinking: Apply logical reasoning and critical thinking to analyze legal issues and make informed decisions.
  • Attention to Detail
  • Problem-Solving

We offer:

  • Competitive compensation package including comprehensive medical, dental and life insurance coverage;
  • Meal allowance;
  • Enjoy a collaborative and supportive work environment where new ideas and perspectives are encouraged and valued;
  • Have the opportunity to make a significant impact on the company and the industry as a whole;
  • Partially or fully paid additional training courses, including English classes, and regular external and internal training.

title: Head of AML (MLRO)
description:
At bet365, we're one of the world's leading online gambling companies, revolutionising the industry since 2000. Founded by Denise Coates CBE, we now employ over 9,000 people and serve over 100 million customers in 27 languages. Our focus on In-Play betting has solidified our market-leading position, offering an unmatched experience across 96 sports and 700,000 streaming events. With over 750 concurrent sporting fixtures at peak and more live sports streamed than anyone else in Europe, we handle over 6 billion requests daily and process more than 2 million bets per hour at peak.

We empower our employees to push boundaries and explore new ideas, cultivating a culture that celebrates and rewards creativity. This offers employees a wealth of opportunities for growth, giving them the opportunity to make a real impact in the world of online gambling. As a forward-thinking company, we’re breaking new ground in software innovation too, redefining what’s possible for our customers worldwide.

Job Description

An experienced and highly motivated Head of AML (MLRO) to lead our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) efforts in Brazil.

You will be responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing our AML programme, ensuring adherence to local regulations.

Please apply with an English version of your CV.

Qualifications

  • Relevant qualifications, including Association of Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialists (ACAMS) certification.
  • Proven experience in AML compliance within the online gambling or financial services industry.
  • In-depth knowledge of Brazilian AML regulations and international standards.

Additional Information

  • Developing and implementing a comprehensive AML strategy in line with Brazilian regulations and international best practices.
  • Acting as the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and serving as the primary point of contact for all AML related matters.
  • Monitoring and assessing the effectiveness of the AML programme, making necessary adjustments to policies and procedures as required.
  • Conducting risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential AML risks associated with our operations.
  • Overseeing the customer due diligence (CDD) process, ensuring compliance with KYC (Know Your Customer) requirements.
  • Providing training and guidance to staff on AML policies, procedures, and regulatory obligations.
  • Liaising with regulatory authorities, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders on AML matters.
  • Preparing and submitting required reports to regulatory bodies, including suspicious activity reports (SARs).
  • Keeping up to date with emerging trends and changes in AML regulations, ensuring the company remains compliant.
  • Collaborating with other departments to promote a culture of compliance and integrity within the organisation.

Chosan is hiring a Virtual Operations Specialist (VOS) to support our fast growing luxury housing and lifestyle platform. This role sits at the center of day to day operations and leasing and is ideal for someone who is organized, responsive, and comfortable handling multiple workflows at once.

description:
Referência em inovação, criatividade e respeito às diferenças, o Publicis Groupe é o grupo de comunicação mais valorizado no mercado. • Garantir consistência, organização e cumprimento de prazos em toda a operação.

• Conhecimento em acompanhamento de campanhas offline (TV, OOH, rádio ou mídia impressa);

• Conhecimento em plataformas digitais como Google Ads (Meta Ads é diferencial);

• Perfil organizado, analítico, atento a detalhes e com boa gestão de prazos;

• Boa capacidade de execução em ambientes dinâmicos e times enxutos.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.

Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.

We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.

While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.

Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.

Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance

Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements

Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team

Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Health and dental plan

description:
⚠️International Opportunity! Position is based in Angola!

You will be joining a well-established market leader, large group with diversified businesses portfolio, reporting to the Demand Planning Manager and responsible for the following:

Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts for decision-making
  • Analyze sales data and market trends to improve forecasting
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on factors that impact demand
  • Monitor sales and refine forecasts based on changing conditions
  • Communicate forecast updates to supply planning teams

  • Review and analyze historical sales data to identify trends and patterns that can be used to improve accuracy of future forecasts

  • Communicate forecast recommendations and updates to stakeholders across the organization, including senior leadership

  • Publish LE (latest estimate) forecasts and other relevant reports to keep stakeholders informed of demand trends and performance
  • Develop and maintain demand planning dashboard to provide real-time visibility into forecasting and demand planning metrics.
  • As well as be able to generate reports and visualizations to communicate forecast accuracy, demand trends, and potential risks to stakeholders, enabling informed decision-making
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and identify areas of improvement to enhance the reliability and precision of demand planning
  • Provide training and support to end-users on utilizing the demand planning dashboard, ensuring widespread adoption and utilization across the organization

Key Requirements:

  • Willing and able to work in Angola
  • Bachelor's Degree as a minimum in relevant field including Finance, Math or Engineering; MBA and/or other professional qualifications are highly preferred
  • 4+ years of Demand Planning experience in a large organization
  • Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, and inventory / production planning
  • Proficiency in using demand planning and forecasting tools is necessary
  • Proficiency in using forecast accuracy KPIs
  • Strong experience with ERP and demand planning systems (e.g., SAP APO, Oracle Demantra, Kinaxis, Anaplan)
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills; experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)Knowledge of statistical forecasting methods and demand modeling
  • Solid understanding of distribution networks, inventory management, and supply chain dynamics
  • Familiarity with S&OP processes and cross-functional planning
  • Proficiency in analyzing large sets of data and using data visualization tools to identify trends, patterns, and insight
  • Prior FMCG experience will be a plus
  • Ability to influence the decision makers
  • Highest standards of accuracy and precision
  • Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly-driven and self-motivated
  • Proven ability to work with ambiguity

ANALISTA DE PESQUISA CLINICA I

Brasil

#VemSerOC

Pioneira no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclinicas&CO foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência da, Oncoclinicas&CO o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.

Aqui na Oncoclinicas&CO valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.

O que você irá fazer:

Profissional responsável em apoiar na elaboração de estratégias de recrutamento de pacientes potenciais participantes de pesquisa, busca ativa, referenciamento e contrarreferenciamento e avaliação da elegibilidade desses potenciais pacientes.

O que você precisa ter:

Formação superior completa na área da saúde;

Experiência no recrutamento de pacientes para pesquisa clínica;

Bom conhecimento em protocolos de pesquisa clínica;

Vivência com IWRS, CRFs;

Disponibilidade para viagens;

Inglês intermediário.

O que oferecemos:

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas

Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos o CLUDE SAÚDE – uma central de saúde que oferece telepsicologia, orientação médica, nutricional, acompanhamento do pré-natal de gestantes e teleatendimento médico.

Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.

Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO e para ajudar nas compras do mês, um VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO.

Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.

E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.

No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.

E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nosso PROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.

Venha construir com a gente!

E faça parte do time de pessoas extraordinárias que atuam com a missão de vencer o câncer!

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️

About Foundey

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

Para nosotros lo más importante son las personas, estamos comprometidos en construir activamente una cultura y ambiente de trabajo que esté alineado a nuestros valores, apoyando la diversidad, equidad e inclusión.

Ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades sin distinción alguna, apostando a la diversidad en todas sus formas, priorizando que cada persona se sienta bienvenida, valorada y escuchada, y sean tratadas con dignidad y respeto.

title: People Solutions Global Survey Strategy Lead
description:
Lockton is the world’s largest privately held independent insurance brokerage and advisory firm, known for its entrepreneurial spirit, client-first mindset, and collaborative culture. Without outside shareholders, Lockton focuses entirely on delivering innovative solutions that help clients succeed.

In our People Solutions business, we partner with organizations to design benefits, total rewards, and workforce strategies that attract, retain, and engage top talent. From growing companies to global enterprises, we combine deep expertise with actionable insights to create solutions that truly support people and business goals.

Lockton is a great place to work because we value ownership, innovation, and growth. Associates are empowered to make an impact, share ideas, and develop their careers in a culture that emphasizes inclusion, collaboration, and excellence. At Lockton, you can do meaningful work, grow professionally, and be part of a team that genuinely cares about clients and colleagues alike.

The Role

We are seeking a senior leader to shape and execute the strategy, design, governance, and advanced analytics of survey programs that support client decision-making across People Solutions, including employee benefits, workforce strategy, and non-cash compensation. This role focuses on translating complex people strategies and plan design considerations into structured, scalable, and data-driven insights for large and multinational employers.

The position requires deep expertise in employee benefits, total rewards, advanced survey methodology, applied social science judgment in question design, and senior leadership in automated analytics and insight generation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, execution, and governance of global and regional surveys supporting People Solutions priorities, leveraging enterprise survey platforms such as Qualtrics.
  • Establish and maintain methodological and technical standards to ensure data quality, consistency, confidentiality, scalability, and longitudinal comparability across clients and geographies.
  • Design and oversee automated survey workflows in Qualtrics, including complex logic, validation rules, versioning, and multi-country deployment.
  • Apply principles from social science, behavioral economics, and organizational psychology to design survey questions that elicit accurate, reliable, and decision-useful responses from senior HR, Total Rewards, Finance, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop survey frameworks that capture people strategy, benefits philosophy, workforce governance, and risk management practices while minimizing response bias and misinterpretation.
  • Design survey content addressing detailed plan provisions and non-cash compensation, including retirement programs, health and welfare benefits, equity-based compensation, deferred compensation, and other non-cash rewards.
  • Lead the development of scalable, automated analytics pipelines to process survey data, reduce manual intervention, and support repeatable benchmarking, trend analysis, and executive reporting.
  • Partner with analytics and technology teams to integrate Qualtrics outputs with data visualization, benchmarking, and reporting tools (e.g., dashboards and standardized executive reporting).
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, translating automated survey outputs into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Present survey findings to executive audiences with clarity and credibility, supported by standardized and dynamic reporting.
  • Interpret survey data to identify market trends, emerging risks, and opportunities across industries and regions.
  • Partner with actuarial, legal, tax, rewards, and other People Solutions specialists to ensure technical accuracy and regulatory alignment.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Lockton’s People Solutions survey and benchmarking capabilities through innovation, digital enablement, and analytics-led insights.
  • Provide executive-level oversight, coaching, and quality assurance for consulting and analytics teams involved in survey design, automation, and analysis.
  • Support business development efforts by shaping survey-led client solutions, proposals, and market-facing offerings.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Economics, Statistics, Psychology, Sociology, Organizational Behavior, Anthropology, Political Science, or a related field.
  • Experience in people strategy, total rewards, employee benefits, or human capital consulting, preferably within a large professional services or advisory firm.
  • Deep knowledge of People Solutions offerings, including employee benefits, total rewards, workforce strategy, and non-cash compensation plan design.
  • Extensive experience designing and deploying surveys using Qualtrics, including advanced logic, governance controls, and global distribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze survey results in an automated, scalable manner, supporting benchmarking, trend analysis, and executive reporting.
  • Proven experience applying social science or behavioral research principles to survey design, including question framing, response bias mitigation, and construct validity.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence C-suite and senior client stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD, or equivalent).
  • Graduate or advanced study in organizational psychology, behavioral science, economics, sociology, public policy, human factors, or survey methodology, applied in a consulting or business context.
  • Experience integrating Qualtrics with analytics, BI, or data platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, SQL-based environments).
  • Familiarity with governance, regulatory, and compliance considerations related to people programs and compensation.
  • Experience leading or scaling repeatable, productized survey and benchmarking solutions.

title: Senior Client Success Manager
description:
Senior Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Client Success Manager with 7+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.

Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 7+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Buscamos alguém com maturidade para trabalhar com total autonomia , gerindo sua carteira de clientes com a criatividade necessária para inovar dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa dados para fundamentar decisões e montar cartas de vinho estratégicas para o canal gastronômico.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo (cliente, mercado local, concorrência) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente e se reinventa conforme as necessidades dos restaurantes e hotéis da região.

O(A) Representante Comercial será o elo estratégico da Zahil com o segmento On-Trade em Ribeirão Preto. O foco total é construir e gerenciar relacionamentos com os principais restaurantes, hotéis, bares e casas de eventos da região.

A função exige uma prospecção ativa e uma gestão de carteira inteligente, transformando o portfólio Zahil em cartas de vinhos vencedoras e rentáveis para nossos parceiros. Buscamos alguém com agilidade para navegar no dinâmico mercado gastronômico local, atuando como um consultor para donos de restaurantes, sommeliers e gerentes de A&B.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar a carteira On-Trade (restaurantes, hotéis, bares) em Ribeirão Preto, fortalecendo o relacionamento e identificando novas oportunidades.
  • Prospectar ativamente novos estabelecimentos com perfil estratégico para o portfólio Zahil.
  • Análise Consultiva de Cartas: Analisar as cartas de vinho atuais e apresentar rótulos que façam a diferença, considerando harmonização, precificação e perfil do público local.

  • Treinamento de Brigada: Organizar e executar treinamentos para as equipes de salão e sommeliers, focando no conhecimento do produto e em técnicas para impulsionar o giro no salão.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Reportar à gerência as demandas do trade local e ações da concorrência.
  • Gestão Digital: Apoiar no uso de sistemas de CRM para gestão do funil e colocação de pedidos.

Qualificações e Experiência:

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Curso de vinhos (WSET, ABS, etc.) é fundamental para o diálogo com sommeliers.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos em vendas B2B, com experiência comprovada no canal On-Trade .
  • Regionalismo: Residência em Ribeirão Preto e profundo conhecimento da malha gastronômica da cidade.
  • Networking: Relacionamento ativo e carteira pré-existente com donos de restaurantes e gerentes de A&B na região será um grande diferencial.
  • Requisitos Legais: Empresa de representação ativa (CNPJ).

Remuneração e Modelo de Contratação:

  • Regime: PJ (Contrato de Representação Comercial).
  • Remuneração: 5% de comissão de todas as vendas efetuadas.

title: Senior US Immigration Paralegal
description:
Job Title: US. Employment-Based Immigration Paralegal

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-Time

Company: Versfeld & Hugo, LLC

Versfeld & Hugo, LLC is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Employment-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our growing practice. This role is critical to supporting attorneys and clients through all stages of the employment-based immigration process. The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, and experienced in managing immigration matters with precision and professionalism.

Responsibilities:

• Client Communication: Maintain regular contact with clients to provide case updates, respond to inquiries, and request required information and documentation.

• Email & Correspondence Management: Monitor and respond to client and internal emails promptly, ensuring accuracy, professionalism, and clarity in all written communications.

• Form & Petition Preparation: Prepare, review, and complete employment-based immigration forms, petitions, and applications with a high level of attention to detail to minimize errors and delays.

• Phone Communication: Return client calls in a timely manner and provide clear, accurate information while maintaining a courteous and professional demeanor.

• Document Management: Compile, organize, and maintain legal documents and supporting evidence for immigration filings.

• Case Management & Deadlines: Assist attorneys with managing case files, tracking deadlines, and monitoring case progress using internal case management systems.

• Legal Research: Stay current on employment-based immigration laws, regulations, and procedural updates to support accurate case preparation and client guidance.

Qualifications:

• Prior experience as an immigration paralegal or in a related immigration support role required.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines, and prioritize tasks effectively in a remote environment.

• Familiarity with L1, O1, H1B, EB1A, and PERM is strongly preferred.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and immigration case management software.

Working Hours:

This is a full-time position with working hours from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, providing flexibility for work-life balance.

Salary and Benefits:

Compensation for this position is commensurate with experience and qualifications. In addition to salary, we offer a 401(k) retirement plan and provide a monthly stipend toward medical insurance, supporting both long-term financial planning and healthcare needs

How to Apply:

If you are a dedicated and detail-oriented professional who is passionate about immigration law and helping clients achieve their immigration goals, we would love to hear from you. Please send your resume to

Join our team at Versfeld & Hugo, LLC and make a meaningful impact on the lives of our clients by guiding them through the immigration process. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Especialista em Inteligência e Performance de Frotas
description:
A Aegea, criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Objetivo da Posição

Atuar como especialista responsável pela inteligência de dados, análise de performance e inovação na gestão de frotas, transformando grandes volumes de informação em insights estratégicos para suporte às decisões operacionais e gerenciais.

Escopo e Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e consolidar a inteligência de dados da frota , reunindo informações de aproximadamente 10.000 veículos .
  • Construir, manter e evoluir dashboards, relatórios e indicadores (BI) de performance da frota.
  • Analisar dados de produtividade, utilização, ociosidade, rastreamento, condução e custos dos veículos.

  • Monitorar indicadores como autonomia, disponibilidade, padrões de uso e eficiência operacional.

  • Apoiar análises contratuais sob a ótica de dados e performance.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Forte domínio de BI, análise de dados e indicadores .
  • Experiência com grandes bases de dados operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em telemetria e indicadores de performance de veículos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar dados complexos e traduzi-los em insights acionáveis.
  • Diferencial: noções de programação (ex.: Python) para automações e análise avançada de dados.

  • Autonomia, organização e disciplina para atuação como especialista.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara para traduzir dados técnicos em informações de negócio.
  • Boa interação com áreas operacionais e de liderança.

Localidade

  • Atuação majoritariamente interna, sem necessidade recorrente de viagens.

description:
VEM CONHECER A CARBIGDATA!

Somos a maior plataforma de bigdata do mercado de veículos. Nossos produtos possuem foco na localização de veículos roubados, furtados e na verdadeira situação do bem localizado. Com foco em big data analytics, atuamos nos principais players do mercado automotivo como bancos, financeiras, locadoras e seguradoras.

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Você terá a missão de identificar, qualificar e potencializar oportunidades de negócios. Atuará de forma analítica e estratégica, garantindo a geração de leads qualificados e o crescimento da receita da Carbigdata.

Buscamos alguém com perfil consultivo, apaixonado por dados e com energia para acelerar resultados em um ambiente dinâmico e de alta performance.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Prospectar e qualificar leads por meio de estratégias inbound e outbound, utilizando ferramentas como LinkedIn Sales Navigator e participação ativa em eventos do setor.
