  • Mapear empresas e identificar decisores estratégicos alinhados ao perfil de cliente ideal.
  • Acompanhar a jornada do lead, identificando gatilhos que acelerem a conversão.
  • Avaliar o fit dos leads com os produtos e soluções da Carbigdata, aplicando metodologias como BANT e SPIN Selling.
  • Manter o CRM (Pipedrive) atualizado e organizado, enriquecendo dados e segmentando leads conforme o estágio do funil.
  • Agendar reuniões qualificadas para o time de vendas e garantir transições fluidas entre etapas do processo.
  • Responder dúvidas dos leads de forma consultiva e assertiva, apresentando informações relevantes sobre nossos produtos e diferenciais competitivos.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) — como número de ligações, e-mails, reuniões e oportunidades geradas — e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Utilizar dados e ferramentas analíticas para mensurar o impacto de campanhas, identificar gargalos e sugerir otimizações de performance.
  • Fornecer feedbacks ao time de marketing e vendas sobre tendências, dores e oportunidades do mercado.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência prévia em vendas complexas B2B de SaaS, com foco em prospecção e qualificação de leads.
  • Domínio de CRM (preferencialmente Pipedrive).
  • Conhecimento e prática em metodologias de vendas (BANT, SPIN Selling).
  • Vivência com LinkedIn Sales Navigator e técnicas de copywriting para abordagens personalizadas.
  • Raciocínio analítico para interpretar dados e otimizar processos comerciais.
  • Comunicação clara, empatia e capacidade de construir relacionamentos sólidos.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Dayoff no mês do aniversário

  • Atuar próximo ao código e à infraestrutura, orientando tecnicamente o time e garantindo a qualidade das entregas (Code Review, Arquitetura, etc.).

Requisitos obrigatórios (Hard skills):

  • Experiência em liderança: Vivência prévia como CTO ou Head de Tecnologia em startups, preferencialmente tendo estruturado equipes do zero ou participado de fases de escala.
  • Stack tecnológico: Domínio de Node.js, Python e C# .
  • Banco de dados: Forte conhecimento em SQL.
  • Infraestrutura: Conhecimento abrangente de infraestrutura e ambiente 100% Cloud.
  • Visão geral: Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação, Compliance e LGPD.

Requisitos comportamentais (Soft skills) – Essenciais:

  • Capacidade de navegar entre diferentes perfis, gerar empatia e engajar o time (evitando o perfil de "gênio técnico isolado").
  • Perfil resolutivo que tome decisões difíceis sem necessidade de validação constante por comitês.

Diferenciais competitivos:

  • Experiência com projetos envolvendo reconhecimento facial é um diferencial de alto valor.
  • Vivência em empresas de RH, Seguradoras, Bancos ou meios de pagamento (foco em segurança/antifraude).

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:
Técnico de Lubrificação Sr

Executar e supervisionar planos de lubrificação preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos rotativos e estáticos; Definir, avaliar e aplicar os tipos adequados de lubrificantes (graxas, óleos, fluidos especiais), assegurando conformidade com especificações técnicas e recomendações de fabricantes; Monitorar o consumo e desempenho dos lubrificantes, realizando análises de tendência e propondo melhorias de confiabilidade; Realizar coleta de óleo para análise laboratorial (físico-química e ferrográfica), interpretando resultados e recomendando ações corretivas; Implementar e manter rotas de lubrificação em sistemas digitais (CMMS/ERP), garantindo rastreabilidade das atividades; Diagnosticar falhas relacionadas a sistemas de lubrificação e propor soluções para eliminação de recorrências; Orientar e treinar equipes de manutenção quanto às melhores práticas de lubrificação e inspeção de equipamentos; Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas de manutenção, fornecendo suporte técnico sobre processos de lubrificação; Atuar junto às áreas de engenharia de manutenção e confiabilidade no desenvolvimento de novos procedimentos e otimização de intervalos de lubrificação; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade na manipulação, armazenamento e descarte de lubrificantes.

Atividades:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial

Requisitos & Competências:

Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

title: Representantes de Negócio
description:
Grow Up by MetLife | Representantes de Negócio

Sobre a iniciativa

Sua empresa poderá fazer parte de uma iniciativa estratégica da MetLife voltada ao desenvolvimento de Representantes de Negócio, com foco em expansão comercial e construção de operações sustentáveis.

O Grow Up by MetLife foi concebido para empresas com expertise empresarial que atuam com protagonismo estratégico, alinhando a operação própria ao modelo de negócios da companhia.

A oportunidade

O Grow Up by MetLife é um programa de aceleração executiva, estruturado para transferir know-how para futuros parceiros comerciais na modalidade de Representantes MetLife.

  • Etapa 1 – Base de Negócios (6 meses): imersão prática no negócio, desenvolvimento comercial, conhecimento técnico de produtos e relacionamento com clientes.
  • Etapa 2 – Consolidação (18 meses): ampliação de atuação, construção de carteira, visão de gestão e apoio à expansão comercial.
  • Etapa 3 – Escalada: consolidação como líder de negócio, com autonomia, estrutura própria e capacidade de multiplicar resultados.

A jornada contempla etapas progressivas de desenvolvimento em gestão comercial, governança e expansão territorial, com foco em resultados de longo prazo. Em decorrência da progressão, o parceiro terá o know-how relacionado ao desenvolvimento de mercado e consolidação de resultados, culminando na condução de uma operação própria, com autonomia estratégica.

Principais objetos do modelo de parceria

- Conduzir a estratégia de expansão comercial do seu negócio em parceria com a MetLife na região de atuação da sua empresa, a partir de análises de mercado e planejamento estratégico.

- Estruturar, assessorar e dar suporte a Parceiros Comerciais, assegurando produtividade e qualidade.

- Gerir e expandir a carteira de negócios de sua empresa com foco em crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e recorrência.

- Atuar de forma consultiva junto a clientes e parceiros estratégicos, fortalecendo relacionamentos.

- Assegurar excelência técnica e conformidade com as diretrizes legais e administrativas.

Requisitos para atuação no programa

- Atuação empresarial consolidada em atividades comerciais, preferencialmente consultivas, complexas e de alta responsabilidade.

- Experiência da empresa em projetos de expansão ou desenvolvimento de operações comerciais.

- Capacidade analítica, visão estratégica e domínio técnico para tomada de decisões no nível empresarial.

- Presença e penetração de mercado, com influência e capacidade de negociação em diferentes níveis.

- Perfil empresarial empreendedor, com compromisso com resultados e construção sustentável no longo prazo.

Diferenciais

- Histórico consistente da empresa na formação, desenvolvimento e gestão de times comerciais.

- Atuação prévia da empresa como representante ou responsável por unidades de negócio.

- Capacidade da empresa de estruturar processos comerciais e indicadores de performance.

Por que o Grow Up by MetLife

O Grow Up by MetLife é destinado a empresas que buscam solidez, independência estratégica e geração de valor, contando com o respaldo institucional de uma multinacional e a liberdade de empreender.

title: Mainframe Manager
description:
Job Title: Mainframe Manager

Remote

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe Manager to lead and oversee complex mainframe initiatives, ensuring successful project delivery and seamless integration with business operations. This role requires deep technical expertise in IBM Mainframe environments combined with strong project management, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and cost optimization capabilities. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, the ability to drive change, and a track record of delivering large-scale mainframe projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end mainframe projects by defining scope, developing detailed project plans, setting timelines, and managing resources.
  • Provide technical leadership across IBM Mainframe technologies, including z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, and REXX.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and end users.
  • Conduct risk assessments, identify potential issues, and develop mitigation and contingency plans.
  • Manage project budgets, track expenses, and optimize costs while maintaining delivery quality.
  • Guide and mentor project and technical teams, fostering collaboration and accountability.
  • Oversee project execution to ensure alignment with approved plans, milestones, and timelines.
  • Ensure clear and consistent communication, proactively managing stakeholder expectations and concerns.
  • Manage vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and ensure delivery against agreed SLAs and milestones.
  • Assess and manage the impact of mainframe migrations on existing systems, processes, and workflows.
  • Drive continuous improvement through process optimization and effective change management practices.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

  • Mainframe Technologies: Advanced proficiency in z/OS and AS400 environments.
  • Programming & Scripting: Strong working knowledge of COBOL, JCL, REXX, and SAS.
  • Project Management: PMP certification with hands-on experience managing large-scale, complex projects.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to engage, influence, and manage senior business and technical stakeholders.
  • Risk & Vendor Management: Strong experience in risk assessment, mitigation planning, and vendor collaboration.
  • Change Management: Demonstrated ability to lead change initiatives and drive process improvements.
  • Team Leadership: Strong people management skills with experience leading and motivating technical teams.
  • ITIL: Solid understanding of IT service management best practices.

title: Dev Full Stack
description:
Empresa

Soluções digitais que evoluem com o seu negócio. Potencializando resultados.

Descrição da função

Estamos crescendo rápido e precisamos de três Dev Full Stack experientes para acelerar nossos projetos. Aqui no nosso time não temos hierarquia pesada, todo mundo trabalha e decide junto com o team leader — e responde direto ao CEO (eu mesmo). Você terá autonomia real para definir arquiteturas, implementar features do zero e impactar os usuários sem burocracia ou camadas desnecessárias. Stack principal: Node.js no backend (APIs robustas e escaláveis), React para interfaces web modernas e/ou Flutter para apps mobile cross-platform de alta performance. Valorizamos código limpo, testes, CI/CD e soluções que resolvem problemas de verdade — nada de só 'entregar ticket'. Nossa base é em Porto Alegre/RS, com modelo presencial flexível, salário competitivo + participação nos resultados, projetos inovadores e a chance de crescer junto com a empresa desde cedo. Se você ama construir soluções que fazem diferença, foge da mesmice corporativa e quer um ambiente onde sua voz conta de verdade, me manda mensagem ou aplique aqui!

Qualificações

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Desenvolvedor Full Stack (ou equivalente em backend + frontend/mobile), com portfólio ou projetos comprovados.
  • Domínio sólido em  Node.js (backend: APIs REST/GraphQL, Express/NestJS, escalabilidade, autenticação, integrações).
  • Experiência forte em  React (frontend web: componentes reutilizáveis, hooks, state management com Redux/Zustand/Context, Next.js é diferencial).

  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.

  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.

Key skills :

  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.

  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

O objetivo é fortalecer uma cultura data-driven, com excelência técnica, comunicação clara e foco em resultados.

Cultura da klavi

  • Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.

  • Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.

  • Analisar grandes volumes de dados para identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de negócio.

  • 3+ anos de experiência em indústria ou varejo (ou contextos similares de dados em escala).
  • Vivência em análise de mercado, CRM, precificação ou planejamento comercial.
  • Proficiência avançada em Python e SQL para manipulação, análise e modelagem de dados em larga escala.
  • Domínio de estatística descritiva e inferencial aplicada à análise de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Capacidade comprovada de transformar dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e influência com stakeholders.

title: Rust Developer
description:
About You

You are a senior software engineer who enjoys building high-performance, reliable, and secure systems. You’re passionate about low-level efficiency, correctness, and modern software design, and you thrive in environments where performance, safety, and scalability truly matter.

You’re looking for a role where you can influence technical decisions, work on challenging backend systems, and collaborate with strong engineering teams while continuously sharpening your Rust expertise.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience using Rust in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of Rust’s ownership model, lifetimes, memory safety, and concurrency patterns.
  • Experience building high-performance backend services, APIs, or system-level components using Rust.
  • Strong knowledge of asynchronous programming in Rust (e.g., Tokio, async/await).
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs, gRPC, or other service communication patterns.
  • Familiarity with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) and data persistence strategies.
  • Experience with testing, debugging, and performance profiling in Rust.
  • Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and system-level concepts.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, clean code, and maintainable architectures.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance and reliable backend systems using Rust.
  • Build and optimize services with a strong focus on performance, safety, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, DevOps, product) to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical decision-making.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable Rust code following best practices.
  • Debug complex issues related to concurrency, memory usage, and system performance.
  • Integrate Rust services with external systems, APIs, and data stores.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and continuous improvement of development processes.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
  • Mentor other engineers and share knowledge around Rust best practices when applicable.

title: DevOps Azure (Realocação para Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What will you be doing?

  • Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure;
  • Manage and operate containerized environments using Kubernetes;
  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery;
  • Ensure system availability, performance, and security;
  • Collaborate closely with development and platform teams;
  • Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to continuous improvement.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • At least 3 years of experience in a DevOps role;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure;
  • Solid experience with Kubernetes;
  • Good understanding of cloud-native architectures;
  • Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, Bicep- nice to have);
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken) , and Portuguese ;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l ).

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Analista de Qualidade para Performance
description:
Código da vaga: 55919

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em Suportar a implementação de testes de performance (k6, JMeter ou similar)

Garantir que as automações identifiquem regressões ou gargalos antes de ir para produção

Acompanhar KPIs de performance e estabilidade da esteira.

Desenvolvimento de scripts de teste.

Análise de performance da aplicação (lentidão, gargalos, fluidez e necessidade de manutenção)

Automatizar processos de build, deploy e validações

Criar e manter scripts para automações

Construir, manter e otimizar pipelines CI/CD

Hibrido 1 dia na semana- São Paulo

CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Consultor(a) de Vendas - On Trade São Paulo
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada negócio como uma oportunidade de construir uma parceria duradoura. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia , gerir sua carteira de clientes e a criatividade para inovar dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa dados para fundamentar decisões criativas e montar cartas de vinho estratégicas.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo (cliente, mercado, concorrência) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente e se reinventa conforme as necessidades do mercado e dos clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades (do restaurante, do hotel) e propõe soluções de portfólio e serviço.
  • Resiliência: Transforma os desafios da negociação e do dia a dia em oportunidades de crescimento.

Descrição do Cargo

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas On-Trade é uma peça-chave na estratégia da Zahil em São Paulo. Ele(a) é responsável por construir e gerenciar relacionamentos com os principais restaurantes, hotéis, bares e casas de eventos da cidade. A função exige uma prospecção ativa e uma gestão de carteira inteligente, transformando o portfólio Zahil em cartas de vinhos vencedoras e rentáveis para nossos parceiros.

É preciso agilidade para navegar no dinâmico mercado de restaurantes de São Paulo. Flexibilidade, capacidade de improvisação e vontade de aprender constantemente. O objetivo é ser um parceiro estratégico para o cliente (o dono do restaurante, o sommelier, o gerente de A&B), garantindo visibilidade, treinamento da brigada e o crescimento mútuo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes On-Trade (restaurantes, hotéis, bares) em São Paulo, fortalecendo o relacionamento e identificando oportunidades.
  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com perfil estratégico para o portfólio Zahil.
  • Analisar as cartas de vinho dos clientes e apresentar os rótulos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença, considerando harmonização, "pricing" e perfil do estabelecimento.
  • Negociar a inclusão de novos rótulos, ações de visibilidade (ex: vinho em taça, "wine dinners") e condições comerciais.
  • Organizar e executar treinamentos para a brigada (equipe de salão, sommeliers) dos clientes, focando no conhecimento do produto e em técnicas para impulsionar o "sell-out".
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos clientes (volume, mix de produtos) e propor ações para atingir as metas.
  • Transmitir à gerência as dificuldades, demandas do mercado (concorrência, preços) e oportunidades que ultrapassem sua autonomia.
  • Manter o time comercial informado sobre todas as atuações e comunicações da Zahil, chegada de produtos, mudanças de preços e promoções.
  • Apoiar no uso dos sistemas internos de CRM (para gestão do funil) e de faturamento (para colocação de pedidos).

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos técnico ou de extensão (WSET, ABS, etc.) é fundamental.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês ou espanhol
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de três anos em vendas B2B, com experiência comprovada no canal On-Trade de bebidas (especialmente vinhos).
  • Networking: Um relacionamento ativo e uma carteira pré-existente com sommeliers, donos de restaurantes e gerentes de A&B em São Paulo será um grande diferencial.
  • Habilidades: Forte capacidade de negociação, comunicação, organização e perfil "hunter" (caçador).

Remuneração:

  • Regime PJ: R$ 6.000,00 (seis mil reais) de salário fixo

title: NetDevOps Engineer - Remote
description:
NetDevOps Engineer - Remote

The Environments team is responsible for setting up and maintaining platforms used for development and testing throughout Global Fabric. Our main tasks include:

  • Creating and managing virtual machines using on-premises cloud.
  • Running cloud infrastructure on AWS.
  • Overseeing and monitoring both our infrastructure and the Global Fabric applications that sit on top of it.
  • Guaranteeing consistent connectivity across different environments.
  • Deploying Global Fabric applications both on-premises and in the cloud.
  • Providing any extra platform features our internal developers and testers need.

Role Overview

As a NetDevOps engineer, you will apply your technical expertise to Global Fabric and use your skills to build and manage environments.

  • Automation & Scripting: Writing scripts (Python) and using tools (Netbox and Itential) to automate repetitive network tasks, configuration, and testing.
  • Network State Management: Using tools provided to you (i.e. Netbox / Itential) managing the Underlay (telecommunications) equipment that we have in each environment. Taking a step back and understanding how we can automate these activities further.
  • Troubleshooting and Faulting: Using expertise and understanding of Python and associated skills to troubleshoot and identify fixes for issues found during the deployment/management of services.
  • API Utilisation: Using APIs for programmatic control over network devices rather than just command-line interfaces (CLI).
  • Collaboration: Working closely with development and operations teams to align network services with application needs.
  • Testing & Monitoring: Implementing automated testing (unit, integration) and monitoring for network health and policy compliance.

Skills Required

  • Strong automation and scripting with Python, including tooling to troubleshoot complex issues.
  • Understanding of containerisation technologies, with practical experience using Kubernetes.
  • Good understanding of JSON and how structure relates to YANG.
  • Solid awareness of cybersecurity principles, including risk impact, continuous auditing, and compliance validation.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.
  • Strong understanding of how networks function and work ideally to an ISP standard
  • Understanding of commonly used protocols, including: IS-IS, BGP, VPN, Vlans, STP, DHCP, DNS, AAA (TACACS), SNMP, Streaming Telemetry.
  • Understanding of ISP related processes on interconnecting large Autonomous Systems. Peering, Transit, etc
  • Demonstrable understanding of IOS-XR and Cisco operating systems.
  • Experience with Cisco based routing and switching platforms including: Cisco 57C3 o Cisco 8200, Cisco Nexus Platforms

This role is essential to strengthening operational leadership, driving performance, supporting organizational transformations, and ensuring a safe, productive, and engaged work environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a strategic partner to Manufacturing and Operations leadership, supporting people-related decisions aligned with business objectives;
  • Support leaders in the development of operational teams, supervisors, and coordinators, with a focus on performance, operational discipline, and engagement;
  • Lead performance management processes, including feedback, evaluations, and Individual Development Plans (IDPs);
  • Support training and development initiatives, including technical training, behavioral development, and industrial leadership development;
  • Lead and support Recruitment and Selection processes, partnering with leaders to define profiles, prioritize vacancies, and support hiring decisions aligned with business needs;
  • Support internal mobility processes, succession planning, promotions, and operational talent management;
  • Analyze HR indicators (turnover, absenteeism, overtime, headcount, engagement, safety, etc.) and propose action plans;
  • Lead and support change management processes, organizational restructures, and process improvement initiatives;
  • Ensure consistent application of HR policies within the manufacturing environment;
  • Support culture, organizational climate, and employee experience initiatives in an industrial context;
  • Support industrial teams in managing internal conflicts.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields;
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA is a plus;
  • Solid experience as an HR Business Partner or HR Generalist in industrial or manufacturing environments;
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in the area;
  • Strong experience working with operational leadership and shop floor environments;
  • Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills across different organizational levels;
  • Analytical profile with the ability to work with HR metrics and data;
  • Experience with ADP, SAP (SuccessFactors), and/or HCM systems;
  • Advanced Excel skills;
  • Advanced or fluent English;
  • Spanish is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in multinational companies;
  • Experience with Power BI;
  • Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence tools and applications;
  • Experience in highly complex industrial environments and matrix structures;
  • Participation in continuous improvement projects (Lean, Six Sigma, or organizational transformation);
  • Experience in environments undergoing change, expansion, or manufacturing restructuring.

title: Técnico de Polissonografia
description:
* Atenção, candidato! O Sírio-Libanês NÃO solicita dados pessoais (documentos, dados bancários) ou pagamentos por WhatsApp, telefone, e-mail ou redes sociais. Nosso único canal oficial para inscrições é o site do Hospital Sírio-Libanês, na seção 'Trabalhe Conosco'.

É uma Pessoa com Deficiência? Esta vaga também é para você!

Olá, somos o Sírio-Libanês!

Somos uma instituição de saúde centenária, que através da sua atuação em mais de 60 especialidades, tem como propósito levar vida plena e digna a um número cada vez maior de pessoas. A cada ano, contribuímos para a formação de profissionais da saúde e atendemos milhares de pacientes.

Nos orgulhamos do nosso caráter filantrópico, de um compromisso social genuíno e de sermos uma das melhores instituições de saúde do mundo reconhecida pela revista Newsweek (2023) além de sermos uma empresa TOP Employers, nos destacando entre as melhores instituições do mundo em práticas de Recursos Humanos.

Desta maneira, acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade.

Queremos você para fazer parte dessa história!

Nesta posição você será responsável pelo:

  • Acompanhar o exame do paciente na sua integralidade;
  • Assegurar a perfeita execução do exame, instalando eletrodos em pontos específicos do corpo do paciente, acompanhando todas as fases;
  • Assegurar o perfeito funcionamento dos equipamentos, observando e corrigindo alterações detectadas, tanto com relação ao equipamento quanto a eletrodos desconectados durante o sono do paciente;
  • Determinar a necessidade de equipamentos auxiliares requeridos para a realização do exame;
  • Determinar/verificar os parâmetros a serem monitorizados durante o exame;
  • Registrar os comportamentos do paciente durante o exame;
  • Reportar intercorrências ocorridas durante o sono do paciente, as quais possam gerar laudos equivocados ou alterações significativas nos resultados;
  • Tomar as precauções e protocolos necessários de acordo com as necessidades do paciente.

Para esta posição é essencial ter:

  • Formação obrigatória em Técnico em Polissonografia;
  • Vivência obrigatória na área de Polissonografia;
  • Desejável conhecimento em titulação de pressão positiva em ventilação não invasiva (modo CPAP e BiPAP), incluindo manuseio dos equipamentos, ajustes básicos de parâmetros, colocação e orientação ao paciente quanto ao uso adequado durante exames e terapias, bem como identificação de intercorrências relacionadas ao tratamento.

title: Coordenador(a) de Gestão de Frotas
description:
A Aegea, criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Atuar na coordenação estratégica e operacional da gestão de frotas em nível nacional, garantindo eficiência dos processos, controle financeiro, cumprimento de prazos, gestão de contratos e liderança de equipes, com forte interface com fornecedores, áreas internas e unidades operacionais.

Escopo e Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a gestão de uma frota nacional com aproximadamente 10.000 veículos , distribuídos em diversas operações no Brasil.
  • Liderar equipes (estimativa de 10 a 12 pessoas ) organizadas por células de atuação: medições, pagamentos, manutenção, abastecimento, telemetria e gestão de multas.
  • Gerir pagamentos nacionais relacionados à frota, com alto volume financeiro (aprox. R$ 700 milhões/ano ).
  • Garantir controle rigoroso de prazos, medições, conciliações e relacionamento com fornecedores (aprox. 30 fornecedores ).
  • Atuar fortemente na gestão de contratos , assegurando aderência a SLA, compliance e eficiência operacional.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores (KPIs) operacionais, financeiros e de performance da frota.
  • Conduzir a centralização e redesenho de processos , apoiando a estruturação da nova cadeira e amadurecimento da operação.
  • Gerenciar processos críticos como manutenção, abastecimento, telemetria e gestão de multas (identificação de condutor, controle de infrações e mitigação de riscos).
  • Atuar como ponto focal de relacionamento com áreas internas (contabilidade, financeiro, operações) e externas.
  • Realizar viagens frequentes (em média 1 dia por semana), principalmente para reuniões operacionais e acompanhamento de unidades.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência robusta em gestão de grandes frotas (preferencialmente acima de milhares de veículos).
  • Forte vivência em gestão operacional, processos, indicadores e contratos .
  • Conhecimento técnico em manutenção de frota, abastecimento, telemetria e gestão de multas .
  • Experiência com pagamentos de grande volume e alta criticidade .
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão, com diferencial para SAP .
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de dados operacionais e financeiros.

Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Perfil resiliente, com alta capacidade de atuação sob pressão e prazos críticos.
  • Forte habilidade de liderança, gestão de pessoas e relacionamento interpessoal .
  • Postura prática, mão na massa e orientada a processos robustos.
  • Flexibilidade quanto ao modelo híbrido, com presença frequente em Indaiatuba/SP , especialmente no início da estruturação da área.

Localidade

  • Base principal: Indaiatuba/SP
  • Modelo híbrido com flexibilidade conforme demanda operacional.

Nós oferecemos:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
About Credix

is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, . CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job

We are looking for someone to join Credix as a Sales Engineer . You will own the technical success of client integrations, from pre-sales feasibility to production go-live, ensuring fast activation and long-term integration stability.

Responsibilities

  • Technical pre-sales validation: Lead technical pre-sales by validating feasibility, defining integration scope, and identifying risks before commercial commitment.
  • Integration delivery and go-live readiness: Support sellers through implementation and testing, and act as the technical authority to approve or block go-live based on readiness criteria.
  • Post-go-live integration reliability: Ensure the ongoing health of live integrations by owning issue triage, resolution, or escalation within 24 business hours.
  • Feedback loop to Product and Engineering: Translate integration learnings into actionable feedback to improve platform reliability, scalability, and integration speed.
  • Align technical decisions with commercial outcomes: Partner closely with Sales and Account Managers to ensure integrations support activation, retention, and GMV growth.
  • Customer-facing engagement: Frequently travel to customer sites across Brazil to support integrations, technical alignment, and relationship building.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience working with REST APIs, including authentication, webhooks, error handling, and data modeling.
  • Prior exposure to complex system integrations, preferably in e-commerce platforms (e.g., VTEX) or ERPs.
  • Comfortable working with SQL to investigate integration behavior, validate data flows, and support issue triage using BI tools such as Hex or equivalent.
  • Able to use monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Kibana or equivalent) to identify, diagnose, and communicate production integration issues.
  • Able to produce clear, concise, and structured technical documentation for external partners and internal teams.
  • Organized, proactive, and reliable in driving integrations forward across multiple stakeholders.
  • Curious about customer contexts and constraints, while able to design pragmatic, repeatable integration solutions rather than one-off custom builds.
  • Prioritizes customer success while balancing platform scalability, reliability, and long-term architectural constraints.
  • Operates with high autonomy and ownership, demonstrating strong prioritization, self-direction, and accountability while executing against ambitious targets.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Senior Revenue Operations Manager

We are looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to own and continuously improve our Salesforce instance and broader sales tech stack.

You will maintain and evolve Salesforce, connect and manage key sales tools, and translate revenue data into dashboards and analyses that directly inform sales leadership and frontline reps.

This is a hands-on role for someone with 5-10 years of experience who can operate independently, prioritize intelligently, and partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

Key Responsibilities:

-Salesforce Administration & Ownership

  • Own day-to-day administration of Salesforce (users, roles, profiles, permissions, objects, fields, validation rules, flows, reports, dashboards)
  • Maintain data quality through validation, deduplication, and ongoing hygiene processes
  • Implement and improve sales processes (lead management, opportunity stages, forecasting, pipeline management)
  • Manage releases, sandbox testing, and change management

-Sales Tech Stack & Integrations

  • Manage and maintain integrations between Salesforce and other GTM tools (e.g., HubSpot/Marketo, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo, CPQ, billing tools)
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and coordinate with vendors as needed
  • Evaluate new tools and support implementation and rollout

-Reporting, Dashboards & Insights

  • Build and maintain dashboards for sales leadership and reps (pipeline, forecast, activity, conversion rates, performance)
  • Produce recurring and ad hoc analyses to support forecasting, territory planning, quota setting, and performance reviews
  • Translate unstructured data into actionable business insights

-Cross-Functional Revenue Support

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success to align systems and data
  • Support planning cycles (forecasting, QBRs, capacity models)
  • Act as a trusted operational partner to sales leadership

Required Qualifications:

  • 5-10 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Salesforce Administration
  • Hands-on experience administering Salesforce in a production environment
  • Strong understanding of sales processes, funnels, and pipeline management
  • Experience managing or supporting sales tech tools and integrations
  • Proficiency with Salesforce reporting and dashboards
  • Ability to translate business questions into data and systems solutions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Administrator certification
  • Experience with tools like HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, Salesloft, Gong, or similar
  • Experience with basic SQL or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Exposure to SaaS metrics (ARR, MRR, churn, CAC, LTV)

Why This Role

title: ANALISTA TREINAMENTO VENDAS | CEARÁ
description:
Local: FORTALEZA, CEARÁ

Missão

Garantir a execução da estratégia comercial no campo por meio de treinamentos , consultorias e desenvolvimento de líderes regionais . Foco em aumentar produtividade , qualidade de rota e rentabilidade das operações , conectando método, comportamento e resultado .

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Treinamento prático de supervisores em rota, desenvolvendo liderança, aplicação de feedback e acompanhamento consistente de resultados.

title: TIBCO EBX Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Java development, ideally applied within TIBCO EBX extensions or customizations;
  • Hands‑on experience developing on TIBCO EBX (data modeling, workflows, services, UI configuration, data quality rules);

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal and in here will be 2x on-site.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
Location: Remote (Brasil)

Compensation: USD $4,000–$5,000/month

Working Hours: 8 AM – 5 PM CT

Overview

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Backend Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in designing and maintaining API'S and micro services using Node and TypeScript. This role involves integrating with third-party APIs, managing databases, and mentoring junior team members to enhance the technical capabilities of our team.

Core Responsibilities

- Design and maintain REST ful APIs and micro services using Node. and TypeScript.

- Integrate securely and reliably with third-party APIs.

- Manage and understand databases, particularly SQL, with a preference for experience in Prisma ORM.

- Utilize AWS Cloud for infrastructure management.

- Use Git for code versioning, with familiarity with GitHub.

- Provide mentorship and guidance to mid-level and junior developers.

- Work with containerization technologies, particularly Docker.

- Participate in Agile Methodology, including stand-up meetings and sprint planning.

✅ Requirements

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in backend development.

- Proficiency in Node and TypeScript.

- Strong understanding of REST ful APIs.

- Experience with containerization, especially Docker.

- Basic experience with AWS.

- Proficient in using Git for version control.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to autonomously resolve issues.

- Ability to communicate complex problems in a simple manner and discuss trade-offs.

-English and Spanish Advanced

✨ Nice-to-Have

- Experience with Prisma ORM for database management.

- Familiarity with asynchronous execution tools such as RabbitMQ, Kafka, or BullMQ.

- Experience with Temporal for durable and reliable async execution.

- Knowledge of CircleCI for Continuous Development and Integration.

- Familiarity with Kubernetes for managing containers.

- Understanding of Agile Methodology and related practices.

We are looking for individuals who are passionate about mentoring and elevating the team’s overall quality. If you are a problem solver with strong technical skills and experience, we encourage you to apply

Role reports to: Sr. Manager: Automation & AI Platforms
Location: Sao Paulo/Brazil
Travel %: 10%
What you will do
The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.
This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.
  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the design, development, deployment, and quality assurance of automation projects in accordance with Enterprise IA Delivery Methodology.
  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.
What we are looking for
Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.
What's in it for you
· Competitive Benefit Package*
· Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!
· Learning & Development Opportunities
· Employee Resource Groups
· This list could vary based on location/region

Location: Sao Paulo/Brazil
Travel %: 10%
What you will do
The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.
This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.
  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the design, development, deployment, and quality assurance of automation projects in accordance with Enterprise IA Delivery Methodology.
  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.
What we are looking for
Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.

Role reports to: Sr. Manager: Automation & AI Platforms
Location: Sao Paulo/Brazil
Travel %: 10%
What you will do
The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.
This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.
  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the design, development, deployment, and quality assurance of automation projects in accordance with Enterprise IA Delivery Methodology.
  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.
What we are looking for
Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.
What's in it for you
· Competitive Benefit Package*
· Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!
· Learning & Development Opportunities
· Employee Resource Groups
· This list could vary based on location/region

title: Barbeiro
description: Realize atendimentos de lavagem de cabelos, escova lisa, escova modelada e babyliss pela empresa Bluma. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a empresa oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificados(as). É importante também não estar vinculada a benefícios sociais, como Bolsa Família, BPC ou similares, já que a formalização como MEI implica na perda desses benefícios.

title: Manicure
description:
Realize atendimentos de Manicure, Pedicure e Spa dos pés. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que você mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Os atendimento serão realizados em estabelecimentos da Bluma localizados em aeroportos.
Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a Bluma oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificadas.
